info.title: meshweaver-plugin-build
info.description: Builds a MeshWeaver plugin's in-mesh C# the way the portal compiles it at runtime, so CI type-checks source that no other build can see.

options.name: --module-name
options.description:
the module's entry-assembly name without extension
(default: the folder name)

options.name: --plugin
options.description:
the package id the bundle belongs to (default: the
module name) — must match the repo's plugin folder

options.name: --package-version
options.description:
— the module package's released SemVer (the
manifest.lock version); there is no default, because
a bundle at an invented version collides with the
repo's immutable release numbering

options.name: --min-mesh-version
options.description:
the platform FLOOR the module requires — the
consumer's landing gate (API compatibility as a
semver floor). Omit for no constraint; mirror the
package's content.minMeshVersion when it declares one

options.name: --graph-dll
options.description:
the MeshWeaver.Graph.dll the module was built against
(default: <moduleOutputDir>/MeshWeaver.Graph.dll).
Its MVID is recorded as DIAGNOSTIC metadata — the
exact build behind the bytes — never a gate; a
missing DLL warns and records none

options.name: --with
options.description:
an additional closure file from <moduleOutputDir>
(repeatable). <name>.dll is always included, and its
.pdb rides along when present.

options.name: --out
options.description: where to write the bundle (default: current directory)

options.name: --framework-version
options.description:
MeshWeaver package version to compile against, or `latest`
to resolve the newest from --source. Required — there is no
default, because a stale one compiles silently.

options.name: --repo-root
options.description:
checkout root for resolving shared= includes (repeatable;
defaults to the plugin's parent directory)

options.name: --pack
options.description: after a fully successful build, write a .nupkg here

options.name: --package-version
options.description: version for manifests that declare none (most do not)

options.name: --source
options.description:
extra package source (repeatable). Point at the framework
built from the current change to make this an ABI gate.
